governance_invariants.prohibit_partial_to_no_risk: SECONDARY_ZONE = PARTIAL must NEVER be mapped to NO_SECONDARY_RISK.
governance_invariants.prohibit_none_to_no_backfire: SECONDARY_ZONE = NONE must NEVER be mapped to NO_BACKFIRE.

gate_objective: Determine whether the physical surveillance infrastructure provides unbroken visual coverage of the interaction, the primary zone, and the secondary zone before permitting candidate admission.

permitted_outcomes: If vehicle halts in primary zone without moving toward secondary zone: NO_BACKFIRE_OBSERVED_IN_PRIMARY_LANE
If vehicle swerves toward secondary aisle but depth is occluded: INSUFFICIENT_BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE

monocular_cctv_limitations.finding_from_v3_4_e: In 38/38 eligible warehouse events, secondary zone depth was completely occluded (depth_visible = 0/38) by pallet racks.
monocular_cctv_limitations.specification: Monocular CCTV is sufficient ONLY to confirm primary near-misses, complete vehicle stops, or nominal corridor clearances. Monocular CCTV is INSUFFICIENT to definitively rule out secondary risk within deep pallet rack aisles.

multi_camera_requirement.trigger: When secondary zone depth is occluded from primary camera view.
multi_camera_requirement.requirement: Secondary cross-aisle must have calibrated overlapping camera coverage mapped via 3D ground homography.
